headline: Tata Steel Shares Fall After Announcing 15,510 Crore Deal with APL Apollo Tubes
summary: Tata Steel agreed to acquire a 26.38% stake in APL Apollo Tubes for about ₹15,510 crore while divesting its tubes business and Tata Steel Colours to APL Apollo for ₹28,000 crore.
why: Tata Steel is one of India's largest steel producers, while APL Apollo Tubes is a leading structural steel tube manufacturer.

impacts.name: Tata Steel Ltd
impacts.why: Investor concern over capital allocation and cash flow burden drove share price declines.
